full_page.content:
1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 339 Apr. 23 Wm. Filbin - Starting in business.
Marie Hickey - 27 - keeping company undesirable - mason - no religion.
24 Josephine Juretich - 25 - of Flint - four yrs invalid - shaking and thin, seems perfectly sensible and mentally normal while phys- ically quite helpless .... palsey .... Croations. Asked about Easter -duty - they have been careless - at least a number of them. En- rolled To-day $5. promised to go to holy Sacraments.
24 Canon Baggett - 5 - father o mother Method .... pernicious Enemia had 3 transfusions and removal of spleen. Enrolled last Saturday and steadily improving since .... Father Enrolled To-day.
Marie Jacobs ... 35 ... Jewish ... fearful trouble with eyes & glasses Jos. mc Morris - 49 - vanished 3 mo
Dr. Russill G. Cushing -(about 35-40) recovering from nervous break-down - prominent physician ....
Raymond Lamanski - 24 - ulcers of stomach ... 14 mo. - Communion - 2 a yr ....
Blank Page
Page 340 Page 341 Apr. 23 Lawrence Medici - 9 - "incurable blood-infection ... Enrolled To-day 50c .... . (April 26) reported "decidedly improving hope now that it was not so bad as thought".
Josephine McEroy - 40 - quite alone - fears loss of life savings .... work.
28 Anna Juronoc - ] mo. - paralysed from middle of back - only child. Dr's have no hope of recovery.
Hector Lebert - 8 - of Dearborne - rhumatic heart and blood .... Dr's hopeless.
Mary Scherer - 35 - and 3 small ... husband ... peculiar.
Sylv. Resmer - 23 - student for priesthood - had paraletic stroke - left him lame .... still sighes for ...
Julia Tuer - 78 - fears tumor in stomach or kidney.
